```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parameter-expanded'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY base "base-entity">
  <!ENTITY combined "&base; and &ent;">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising namespaces and PIs -->
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction content"?>
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like strings: <child>&combined;</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&combined;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY % local_macro "<!ENTITY ent_macro 'macro-value'>">
  %local_macro;
  <!ENTITY reference "Entity &ent_macro; Test">
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction test="true" value="123"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/catalog" xmlns:m="http://schemas.example.com/metadata">
  <!-- Multi-line comment 
       with extra details and entities inside -->
  <m:section>
    <?m:pi-target attr="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with unescaped <tags> and &entities;
    ]]>
  </m:section>
  <item id="i1">&reference;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Second &e1; Entity">
  <!ENTITY e3 "Third &e2; Entity">
  <!NOTATION tiff SYSTEM "image/tiff">
  <!ENTITY sample SYSTEM "sample.tiff" NDATA tiff>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<document xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Comment before CDATA and nested namespace nodes -->
  <svg:svg width="100" height="100">
    <?svg-pi action="render"?>
    <![CDATA[
      SVG data stream embedded in CDATA: <rect width="10" height="10"/>
    ]]>
  </svg:svg>
  <section>&e3;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext_pe SYSTEM "http://localhost/nonexistent.dtd">
  %ext_pe;
  <!ENTITY inline_ent "Fallback Content">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "file.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-app-info status="active"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive comment explaining structure and entity fallback -->
  <dc:title>Test Archive</dc:title>
  <record xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Archive entry with special characters: <record> &inline_ent; </record>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&inline_ent;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE response [
  <!ELEMENT response (payload)*>
  <!ELEMENT payload (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e_alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY e_beta "Beta &e_alpha;">
  <!ENTITY e_gamma "Gamma &e_beta;">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY note SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" component="parser"?>
<response xmlns="http://example.net/response" xmlns:api="http://example.net/api">
  <!-- Comment block containing entity references &e_gamma; inside -->
  <api:payload api:version="2.0">
    <?api-control mode="strict"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload payload block: <response>&e_gamma;</response>
    ]]>
  </api:payload>
  <payload>&e_gamma;</payload>
</response>
```
